medications.title: Medications
medications.note: The medication statements recorded for this patient, newest first. Nothing is edited or deleted: a correction or a stop is a new row that replaces the old one. Codes are shown exactly as recorded.
medications.empty: No medication statements are recorded for this patient.
medications.correctTitle: Correct or stop this medication statement?
medications.recordBody: This adds a new row to the patient's record. It cannot be edited afterwards; a later change is another new row.
medications.correctBody: This adds a new row that replaces the row below. The old row stays on record, marked as replaced.
medications.codeHint: A code from this clinic's own list. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores only.
medications.validTo: To (leave empty if no end is recorded)
medications.validToHint: An empty end is saved as "no end recorded". It is not read as "still taking".
medications.notSetUp: This clinic's list of medication codes is not set up yet. Nothing was recorded.
medications.conflict: That row was already replaced, or this request clashes with an earlier one. Reload and try again.
medications.invalid: The code is not in this clinic's list, or the times are not valid. Nothing was recorded.
